subject: Request: staircase headroom + one-time overrun forgiveness window
messages:
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@brightway.ai>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@brightway.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: temporary headroom + overrun forgiveness for launch

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look great. We're kicking off a limited public beta next week and I need a short-term throughput safety net. Our current commit is near the ceiling for our planned traffic spike (expected 36 hours starting Jun 10 UTC).

Request: could Redwood provision a temporary stepped uplift (an extra 200k tokens/day for 3 days, then 100k tokens/day for 4 days — a 'staircase' headroom) and consider a one-time overrun forgiveness (waive the overrun charges for the uplifted tokens for the first month)? If it helps procurement, I attached a draft PO and our Q1 usage so you can see the pattern.

If there's a standard workflow for this (PO, temporary rate tier, or a short-term invoice hold), please advise. We can sign a simple addendum if needed.

Goal: avoid throttling during launch while keeping our finance team comfortable with predictable exposure.

Appreciate a quick timeline — happy to hop on a call.

Best,
Alex
Head of Platform — BrightWay AI

Attachments: BrightWay_PO_Draft.pdf, usage_q1_report.csv

From: irene.choi@redwood.com
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@brightway.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: temporary headroom + overrun forgiveness for launch

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the context and the attachments. Congrats on the beta — we want to make sure traffic flows cleanly. Tentative approach from our side:

- Temporary "staircase" uplift: provision an extra 200k tokens/day for Jun 10–12, then 100k tokens/day Jun 13–16.
- Forgiveness window: Redwood can offer a one-time waiver of overrun unit charges on the uplifted tokens for the first invoice month, up to a cap of 400k total uplifted tokens. Any usage above that cap would be billed at the agreed overrun rate.
- Administrative flow: we need a signed PO (you already have a draft) plus an addendum that lists the uplift schedule and cap. We can deliver the addendum as a short one-page SOW.
- Timing: if we get the signed PO + addendum by EOD Jun 6 PDT, we can lock the uplift and update routing/policies to prevent throttling.

Two quick asks for accuracy: can your team confirm the timezone for the spike (UTC start/end) and whether the 200k/100k numbers are daily maxs or sustained per-hour rates? That changes how we configure autoscale.

I'm looping in Ben (billing) and Laura (AM) to align on the PO wording and the invoice mechanics.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---

From: ben.carter@redwood.com

Subject: Fwd: Quick ask: temporary headroom + overrun forgiveness for launch

Fwding Alex's ask with my notes below.

On Tue, Jun 3, 2025 at 11:05 AM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Alex —
> ...

Internal notes (Ben):
- Finance is OK with a one-time forgiveness up to a capped token amount, but we need a hard cap and an acceptance signature to avoid surprise credits.
- Suggest: cap at 400k uplifted tokens (as Irene proposed) and apply a 30% discount on any overrun that exceeds the cap but occurs within the same invoice month — smooths the bill for Brighton while protecting Redwood.
- Require PO + signed addendum (SOW) with uplift schedule and cap language. After signature we will: 1) create a temporary rate limit increase in the tenant, 2) tag uplifted traffic for reporting, 3) apply waiver/discount in invoice pipeline.

Laura — can you draft the 1‑page addendum and send Alex a DocuSign link? I'll prepare the invoice note and accounting memo.

Ben Carter
Billing Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@brightway.ai>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@brightway.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 07:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: temporary headroom + one-time overrun forgiveness for launch

Irene/Ben/Laura —

Thanks, that sounds workable. Confirming details from our side:
- Spike window: Jun 10 00:00 UTC – Jun 13 23:59 UTC (36-hour heavy window then ramp down to mid-day pattern; global traffic).
- 200k / 100k numbers are daily maxs (not per-hour).
- BrightWay accepts the 400k uplift cap and the one-time waiver up to that cap. If we exceed 400k uplifted tokens, we accept the 30% discounted overrun rate on the excess within the same invoice month.

Procurement will send a signed PO today and I asked them to route the PO + this email thread to you.

One ask from procurement: can we get a short invoice note that explains the waiver/discount phrasing so their accounts payable has a line item to reconcile? If you can include the DocuSign addendum link in the invoice metadata, that helps.

Appreciate the quick turnaround,
Alex

Alex / Procurement team —

Thanks for confirming. Action items and final notes below:

1) Documents: Laura has uploaded a one-page addendum and sent a DocuSign link (DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-def456). Please sign the PO + addendum by EOD Jun 6 to secure the uplift.

2) Operational configuration: upon signed addendum we'll:
   - Provision the staircase headroom (200k tokens/day Jun 10–12, 100k tokens/day Jun 13–16).
   - Tag uplifted tokens with the label "BW8421-temp-uplift" for invoice reconciliation.
   - Apply the one-time forgiveness up to 400k uplifted tokens; any excess in the invoice month will be billed at the overrun rate with a 30% discount applied automatically.

3) Invoice note: Ben will add the following line to the invoice metadata: "Temporary staircase uplift per BW-8421; uplifted tokens waived up to 400,000 tokens; excess billed at agreed overrun rate with 30% discount in invoice month of Jun 2025. DocuSign addendum: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-def456"

4) Post-launch: we'll share a tagged usage report within 5 business days of the lift ending so your AP team can reconcile.

If anything changes on timing, please let us know ASAP. Looking forward to a smooth beta!

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
